state.change: The entire noninteractive preview is now a native link with a visible open-working-website caption and accessible name. The embedded frame stays noninteractive, hidden from assistive technology. Source remains the full Held study.

observed.keyboard: Enter on Open the working Held website navigated to Held; URL and Held heading confirmed. Back returned to Seenry. Tab moves past preview to About the work.
observed.responsive: No horizontal overflow at390 or320. Full desktop hero captured and inspected.
observed.regression: Both composition choices remain usable. Install dialog opens; Escape closes it and returns focus to Get Seenry. Copy previously passed; unchanged copy handler not rerun this round.
observed.coverage: One desktop screenshot and narrow preview inspected this round; prior full-page and source hero boundary evidence retained.
observed.transfer: Six textual cases matched preregistered routes; four evidence controls matched. No fresh rendered transfer website.
observed.limits: No independent designer review, matched reference comparison or human acceptance. No evidence of consistent aesthetic parity.

candidate.instructions: Given the actual observations, what disposition is supported for this limited access repair? Do not infer aesthetic superiority.

criteria.retain_pending: Retain the functional candidate for user review, with quality and human preference limitations explicit.
criteria.revert: Revert because observations show a regression in the changed behavior.
criteria.none: Need more evidence to select any disposition.

next_experiment.instructions: Which next evaluation would most directly test the remaining consistency claim, instead of merely rechecking the same known case?

criteria.fresh_render: Freeze the skill and compare it against the candidate on fresh briefs with equal budgets, matched full-page/reference evidence and independent blind human review.
criteria.repeat_votes: Repeat the same Jev prompt until all probabilities reach1.
criteria.more_docs: Write more generic design rules without rendering.

promotion.instructions: Which shared lesson is supported at this stage?

criteria.scoped: Add the bounded evidence workflow and scoped preview contract; keep aesthetic defaults provisional.
criteria.universal: Require every website to use a giant clickable preview and lavender canvas.
